notes: Fresh installs now ship with the full skill library (the bot installs 21 skills on first run; your edits and bot-authored skills are never overwritten). The Self-extension skill installs itself everywhere with localized cards in all 19 languages. After an in-app update, settings now open on the Updates page showing the new version.
notes_zh: 全新安装现在自带完整技能库（机器人首次运行安装 21 项技能；你的修改与机器人自创技能绝不会被覆盖）。「自我扩展」技能在每台机器自动安装，卡片支持 19 种语言。应用内更新后，设置将直接打开「更新」页面显示新版本。
